question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
-- Get all 20 rows to verify
WITH max_compositions AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        MAX(im.composition) AS max_composition
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.interest_id IS NOT NULL AND im.composition IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY im.interest_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.interest_id,
        mc.max_composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.max_composition DESC) AS top_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.max_composition ASC) AS bottom_rank
    FROM max_compositions mc
),
best_months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (im.interest_id)
        im.interest_id,
        im.month_year,
        im.composition
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.interest_id IS NOT NULL AND im.composition IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY im.interest_id, im.composition DESC
)
SELECT 
    bm.month_year AS time,
    imap.interest_name,
    bm.composition
FROM best_months bm
JOIN ranked r ON bm.interest_id = r.interest_id
JOIN interest_map imap ON bm.interest_id = imap.id
WHERE r.top_rank <= 10 OR r.bottom_rank <= 10
ORDER BY bm.composition DESC

SELECT 
    im.interest_id,
    im.max_composition
FROM (
    SELECT 
        interest_id,
        MAX(composition) AS max_composition
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE interest_id IS NOT NULL AND composition IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY interest_id
) im
ORDER BY im.max_composition DESC
LIMIT 15"}

    GROUP BY im.interest_id

    SELECT 
        mc.interest_id,

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.max_composition ASC) AS bottom_rank
    FROM max_compositions mc
),

    SELECT DISTINCT ON (im.interest_id)
